settings:
# Exploratory follow-up of 12.11.2026 (course folder pro/followup-2026-11-12/plan.md), chosen after the main
# results and two reviews. Not in the plan; decides no hypothesis. Bars and predictions below were
# written before the run. "Reduction" is the relative error reduction of the main report.
#
# E2, leaf size. All 32 datasets, seed 0; minimum leaf size 5 and 20 for every cascade tree (leaf 1 is
# content.toml). 2 x 4 x 32 x 5 = 1,280 tasks. Every comparison is at equal leaf size. Leaf 20 is read only on
# datasets with at least 1,000 training rows, since smaller ones can hardly split at all.
#
# Bars:
# - L1 the noise penalty shrinks: the reduction of target_noise_xx against base is higher (closer to
#   zero or positive) at leaf 5 than at leaf 1 on at least 20 of 32 datasets, at layer 1 and at the chosen
#   layer. Prediction: yes at the chosen layer, open at layer 1.
# - L2 a remedy: at leaf 5 or 20, residual_xx is a clear win over base at the same leaf size (median > 0,
#   at least 20 of 32 better), and base at that leaf size is not worse in median than base at leaf 1.
#   Prediction: no.
# If the penalty shrinks only because base gets worse, that is underfitting, not support.
datasets = "all"
seeds = [0]
outer_folds = 5

[[check]]
name = "leaf5"
methods = ["base", "target_xx", "residual_xx", "target_noise_xx"]
cascade = { min_leaf = 5 }

[[check]]
name = "leaf20"
methods = ["base", "target_xx", "residual_xx", "target_noise_xx"]
cascade = { min_leaf = 20 }
